definitions.gloss: outdoors; the open air; outside (a building)
definitions.explanation: The space outside the doors of a building. Formal and literary; common in written instructions, signage, and academic prose.

examples.japanese: {戸外|こがい}での{運動|うんどう}を{勧|すす}める。
この{植物|しょくぶつ}は{戸外|こがい}でも{育|そだ}つ。
examples.english: This plant can grow outdoors as well.

examples.japanese: {気温|きおん}が{下|さ}がる{冬季|とうき}は{戸外|こがい}での{活動|かつどう}を{控|ひか}えるよう{呼|よ}びかけている。
examples.english: We are calling on people to refrain from outdoor activities in winter when temperatures drop.

notes:
Compound of {戸|こ} (door) + {外|がい} (outside). Literally 'outside the door,' i.e., outdoors.

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. In speech and everyday writing, {屋外|おくがい} or {外|そと} are far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戸外|こがい}{活動|かつどう}: outdoor activity
- {戸外|こがい}{運動|うんどう}: outdoor exercise
- {戸外|こがい}で{過|す}ごす: spend time outdoors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {屋外|おくがい}: outdoor (of a building) — more common in modern usage; standard for signs and instructions
- {野外|やがい}: outdoor (in nature) — emphasizes natural settings, used for concerts and festivals
- {外|そと}: outside — everyday term; broadest in scope
